title: Salary Growth Trend
scenario: Calculate the average salary growth between the project start and project end for each role. Return 'role' and 'avg_growth'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT), employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: This is a proxy request; compare employees across different project start dates.
correctQuery: SELECT role, AVG(salary - LAG(salary) OVER(PARTITION BY role ORDER BY start_date)) AS avg_growth FROM employees e JOIN projects p ON e.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY role;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT); CREATE TABLE employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT); INSERT INTO projects VALUES (1, '2026-01-01', '2026-06-01', 1000), (2, '2026-07-01', '2026-12-01', 1000); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (101, 1, 'Dev', 2000), (102, 2, 'Dev', 2500);
